title: sdk-gg-main HowTo
desc: T2 HowTo: CronCreate schedule, smoke loop procedure, guard cascade escape, CDP 1s QA rule for sdk-gg-main-automation
steps: AUTOMATION: CronCreate(cron=0 star/3 star star star durable=true) fires sdk-gg-main every 3h. Exit=2 spawn Opus for escalation per rules.
POST-ACTION: Log all findings to CLAUDE.md Pending and wkappbot suggest. Re-run after 5min if Amber. Escalate to Opus on critical red flags.
GUARD CASCADE FIX: read wk-ai-tools skill first then wkcodex.sh. wk-only-gate + stall-guard + opus-budget-guard fire together when pace over target. Escape path: wkcodex.sh (harness:safe).

SMOKE LOOP before all gg steps: (1) wkappbot ask gpt say:test -- CDP alive check (2) wkappbot taskkill /IM wkappbot-core.exe --dry-run -- classify works (3) wkjobs.sh -Leaks -- LEAKS=0. Loop until 0 errors, fix inline.
CDP 1s QA RULE: wkcdp-mon.sh LAT avg over 1000ms = bug immediately. All CDP ops under 100ms, hard cap under 1s. State-change detection failure is root cause when over 1s.
AUTO-APPROVE RULE: gg step 0 smoke loop improvements are PRE-AUTHORIZED. Never ask user to confirm gg script improvements. Implement+commit+report immediately.

HAIKU NO-DELEGATION PATTERN: Haiku agents tend to sub-delegate instead of running commands directly. Prevention: add to prompt -- FORBIDDEN: Agent(), Agent.cmd, wkcodex, any delegation tool. MUST run commands yourself via Bash tool. One command at a time. If this instruction is missing, Haiku will recurse and return nothing useful.

usage-test-guard DEADLOCK PATTERN: usage-test-guard (50% random) blocks Agent() and demands Agent.cmd. But Agent.cmd foreground is blocked by -delegation guard. These two guards deadlock. Solution: retry Agent() calls -- usage-test-guard fires only 50% of the time, so retry passes ~50% chance each attempt. Do NOT try Agent.cmd as escape; it always blocks foreground.
